215-1753-4188.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 6 life this turn.
215-1753-4188.description:
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Accomplished Alchemist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Accomplished Alchemist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

670-1619-3175-3967-4681.easyPrerequisites: Sefris' first ability hasn't triggered this turn.
670-1619-3175-3967-4681.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in the second to last room of any dungeon.
670-1619-3175-3967-4681.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Sefris' first ability triggers, causing you to venture into the final room of a dungeon, causing you to complete the dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Yahenni twice by sacrificing Sefris and Sun Titan.
Resolve the Sefris trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into the Cave Entrace room, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into either available room.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Sefris from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sefris enters, Radiant Solar triggers, venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver and into any available room.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.
670-1619-3175-3967-4681.notes: You may instead execute this combo by venturing into Tomb of Annihilation instead of Lost Mine of Phandelver.

4885-5477-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4885-5477-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4885-5477-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

376-618.description:
Activate the mutated Cubwarden and Kiki-Jiki creature by tapping it, creating a token copy of it with haste.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-7415.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Old-Growth Educator.
When Old-Growth Educator dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Old-Growth Educator enters, it triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7330.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Mikey & Mona.
When Mikey & Mona dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mikey & Mona enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2034-3000-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-3000-7306.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token and a creature token due to Chatterfang.
Activate the Mutagen token by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature token.
Repeat.

643-2438-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-2438-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

539-2921-7037.description:
Cast Toph by paying its mana cost
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Toph
When Toph dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Toph enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3755-4038-7008.description:
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by tapping it, adding {1}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1286-4050-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-4298-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-4298-5674-5870.description:
Activate Borborygmos Enraged by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Borborygmos Enraged ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

4377-4543-6333-6678.manaNeeded: {4} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
4377-4543-6333-6678.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat.

1525-5751-6289-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1082-4499-5231-6521.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if a Hare Apparent is in your hand or {3} otherwise, plus {1} if you do not control another Hare Apparent
1082-4499-5231-6521.description:
If you have a Hare Apparent in your hand, cast it by paying {1}{W}. If not, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a Hare Apparent.
When Hare Apparent enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
When the Hare Apparent token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Resolve the Hare Apparent trigger from step 2, creating a number of 1/1 Rabbit creature tokens equal to the amount of other creatures you control named Hare Apparent.
Activate Thermopod up to three times by sacrificing up to three Rabbit tokens, adding up to {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking a nontoken Hare Apparent.
Hare Apparent, Dual Nature's first ability and Dual Nature's second ability trigger.
Resolve the first Dual Nature trigger, creating a token copy of Hare Apparent.
Repeat from step 4.
1082-4499-5231-6521.notes: You should not resolve the Dual Nature second ability triggers. This allows you to continually get more and more Hare Apparents, allowing you to make more Rabbits each iteration. Eventually, once you have infinite Rabbits, you can then stop the combo, sacrifice Rabbits and infinitely blink creatures as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-3259-5359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-5359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Threefold Thunderhulk as attackers.
Threefold Thunderhulk triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2531-4050-4424.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Riptide Pilferer, adding {U}.
When Riptide Pilferer dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Riptide Pilferer from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Riptide Pilferer's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1218-1819-4334.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
1218-1819-4334.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Perpetual Timepiece's second ability by paying {2} and exiling it, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1860-2634-4276.notablePrerequisites: All other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{R}.
1860-2634-4276.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control except Emergence Zone by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they had flash.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Turnabout.
Resolve the copy of Turnabout, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

1339-2034-3908-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God and Spark Double each trigger twice.
Resolve each of the Spark Double and The Locust God triggers, creating a total of four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

141-892.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
141-892.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sublime Epiphany
141-892.description:
Cast Sublime Epiphany by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sublime Epiphany, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Sublime Epiphany, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.
141-892.notes: You may choose more modes from Sublime Epiphany when casting it, if desired.
